questions.question: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, 'The earth is round.'

questions.explanation: Universal truth does not change tense in indirect speech.

BUET ABANDONED the preli MCQ for 2025-26: single written test only (Module A Math/Phy/Chem 400 marks; Module B drawing for Architecture). CKRUET is a written/MCQ test of 400-600 marks (Math/Phy/Chem 150 each + English 50; CUET Group A 500), NOT 100x1-mark MCQ. Items remain usable as HSC-level practice, but the pattern label is wrong and must be corrected before any use.
